name: arrayjoin-domain-env-exfil
note: Env-harvest exfil that hides its C2 host by assembling it from an INLINE array literal joined at runtime (`['web','hook','.si','te'].join('')` -> webhook.site). The de-obfuscation normalizer already folds `+`-concat, template fragments, base64, String.fromCharCode and string reversal, but the inline-array-join form slipped through and DOWNGRADED this block to review. resolveArrayJoins now folds `[<string literals>].join(sep)` (bare/empty/`.`-separated) to the assembled literal so the domain becomes visible and the env-harvest->exfil HIGH fires. A runtime array (`[a,host].join('')`) or non-literal separator is left untouched.
